title: [bug] rpl_stack three_rpl_stacks_send_leaf_dao_via_preferred_parent fails on main: root did not accept the relayed leaf announce
description: lichen-node/src/rpl_stack/tests.rs:1792 assertion 'root did not accept the relayed leaf announce' fails on pre-existing main (verified at commit 1cd8b86784, before any ow1e.111.7 changes). ROOT-DRAIN debug output shows root receiving None for relayed announce. Likely related to announce relay or lichen-link NOT_FOR_US destination filter commit e9d823f006 ('mirror Python NOT_FOR_US destination filter in Rust receive') or l2 same-callback rearm 73b0348eb3.
